items.name: Arrows (20)
items.description: Ammunition for bows. 20 arrows occupy 1 gear slot.

items.name: Backpack
items.description: Holds all gear you can carry; first backpack is free to carry (0 slots when worn).

items.name: Caltrops (one bag)
items.description: Covers a 5-foot area; creatures stepping on them take 1 damage and halve speed until healed.

items.name: Coin
items.description: First 100 coins are free; each additional 100 coins occupy 1 gear slot.

items.name: Crossbow bolts (20)
items.description: Ammunition for crossbows. 20 bolts occupy 1 gear slot.

items.name: Crowbar
items.description: Grants advantage on checks to pry open stuck doors, chests, or crates.

items.name: Flint and steel
items.description: Lights a torch, lantern, or campfire.

items.name: Gem
items.description: Valuable treasure; up to 10 gems per gear slot.

items.name: Grappling hook
items.description: Tied to rope to anchor climbs across chasms or walls.

items.name: Iron spikes (10)
items.description: 10 spikes per gear slot; useful for spiking doors shut or anchoring rope.

items.name: Lantern
items.description: Casts light out to Near distance for 1 hour of real time per oil flask; can be shuttered.

items.name: Mirror
items.description: Small polished steel mirror for peeking around corners or deflecting gaze attacks.

items.name: Oil, flask
items.description: Fuels a lantern for 1 real-time hour, or coats a Close area to burn for 1d4 rounds.

items.name: Pole
items.description: 10-foot wooden pole for prodding floors, chests, and traps from a safe distance.

items.name: Rations (3)
items.description: 3 days of dried trail food (1 gear slot).

items.name: Rope, 60'
items.description: 60 feet of sturdy hemp rope (1 gear slot).

items.name: Torch
items.description: Sheds light out to Near distance for **1 hour of real time** before burning out.
